title: Exploration of the aromatic abietane diterpenoid scaffold in the development of ArnT-mediated colistin resistance inhibitors
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,11061-11075
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09142J, Paper

Silvia Cammarone, Valentina Pastore, Mariya Ryzhuk, Martina Cristoferi, Arianna Speroni, Francesco Imperi, Davide Corinti, Maria Carmela Bonaccorsi di Patti, Bruno Botta, Deborah Quaglio, Mattia Mori, Fiorentina Ascenzioni, Francesca Ghirga
A function-oriented synthesis (FOS) strategy guided the development of abietane-based derivatives as novel inhibitors of ArnT (4-amino-4-deoxy-L-arabinose transferase)-mediated colistin resistance in Pseudomonas aeruginosa.
